blockers.workaround: Investigate alembic/env.py run_migrations_online() — check how it reads the URL for sync engine. May need to set sqlalchemy.url in alembic.ini or fix env.py to use os.environ directly.

decisions.decision: Split Dockerfile into Dockerfile (light) and Dockerfile.pipeline (torch+docling)
decisions.rationale: 4GB RAM machine — all 4 services carrying torch caused OOM crashes during Docker builds
API, beat, runtime worker never call docling — only pipeline worker needs it

decisions.decision: Made docling imports lazy (inside function body) in chunking_service and docling_service
decisions.rationale: API imports Celery task modules at startup which chain-import services that import docling at module level — lazy imports fix startup crash on non-pipeline images

decisions.decision: Changed build-backend from setuptools.backends.legacy:build to setuptools.build_meta
decisions.rationale: setuptools.backends.legacy:build broke with newer pip/setuptools combinations in Docker
fastapi 0.136 does not auto-pull uvicorn; was missing from deps causing executable not found in container
